oneSentenceConcept: A calm, high-signal portfolio surface where AI-native clarity, warm editorial craft, and restrained cinematic motion meet without disrupting content.
trendSummary: The previous seven days favored clarity-first immersive systems: Beaucoup's coherent memorable-experience practice, Lesse Studio's performance-led rebuild, Codex Sites and product-design plugins, spatial agent prompting in Cursor Design Mode, and CSSDA's AI-powered Gucci mystery game all point toward interactive experiences that are directed, useful, and collaborative rather than merely spectacular.

signals.name: Clarity-first creative systems
signals.evidence: Lesse Studio's 2026-06-05 Codrops case study moved from atmospheric experimentation toward clearer navigation, inquiry paths, and dependency discipline.
signals.portfolioImplication: Let the system feel atmospheric, but make reading, scanning, and contacting direct.

signals.name: Memorable systems over isolated effects
signals.evidence: Codrops' 2026-06-01 Beaucoup profile emphasizes coherent storytelling, technology, motion, and visual precision as a way to make experiences memorable.
signals.portfolioImplication: Use one repeatable signature motif in the hero and token system instead of unrelated trend flourishes.

signals.name: AI-native shared surfaces
signals.evidence: OpenAI Codex Sites and Cursor Design Mode both move AI work into annotated, interactive, spatial contexts.
signals.portfolioImplication: Use visual language of signals, annotations, context layers, and live surfaces instead of robot or chatbot tropes.

signals.name: Purposeful story interaction
signals.evidence: CSSDA's Gucci - Mystery Unfolds and recent Awwwards playable worlds connect interactivity to narrative progression.
signals.portfolioImplication: Use the hero as the experimental canvas; keep portfolio structure and case-study copy stable.

signals.name: Warm technical editorial
signals.evidence: Portfolio trend coverage and awarded immersive references combine bold typography, minimal navigation, archival neutrals, and copper or saffron accents.
signals.portfolioImplication: Prefer high-contrast ink text, parchment surfaces, precise borders, and one grounded accent.

direction.contentBoundary: Do not rewrite case-study copy, navigation, routing, or portfolio data.

hero.concept: The hero behaves like a quiet studio control surface: soft parchment light, ink typography, and a slow copper signal trace that suggests agentic context gathering without becoming a dashboard.
hero.motion: Subtle, low-amplitude reveal and drift; no flashing, no scroll hijacking, no continuous high-energy loops.
hero.reducedMotion: Replace drift with a static layered composition and preserve all text hierarchy.

accessibility.contrastTarget: WCAG AA or better for body text and key interactive text
accessibility.motionGuidance: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid aggressive transitions.
accessibility.legibilityGuidance: Use high-contrast foreground on warm light surfaces; avoid beige-on-beige body copy.

avoid: generic AI glow and chatbot ornament
